notes.title: MASSIVE Launch Discount
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503772/5085f8602c8ece3e66a5dfbd0391f436e0688139.png[/img]
Can't thank you guys enough for making this happen.

To celebrate our launch, we are offering a 78% discount on the Birdie Pack. This should help you progress faster in the game.

The Birdie Pack includes

- Free 2,999 coins
- Free Unicorn skin
- Unlimited Revives
- 2x Income
- 2x Bullet recharge
